title: Adaptive Memory for Online Reinforcement Learning under Sparse Model Changes
abstract: arXiv:2611.21879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the discounted reinforcement learning (RL) problem in a setting where the underlying environment changes between deployments. Each deployment provides $H$ observations from a fixed MDP. The reward function and transition kernel are fixed within each deployment. Across deployments, at most an $\epsilon >0$ fraction of the reward and transition kernel entries may change. In this setting, learning each model to deploy from scratch may discard useful observations from past deployments, whereas pooling all past observations can bias the estimates of entries that have already changed. We then propose an algorithm that for each state and action pair, selects how much history to reuse to estimate the reward and probabilities of the next state. translated_title: 稀疏模型变化下在线强化学习的自适应记忆
translated_abstract: 我们研究底层环境在部署之间发生变化的折扣强化学习（RL）问题。每次部署提供来自一个固定MDP的H个观测，奖励函数和转移核在每次部署内部保持固定；而在不同部署之间，最多有比例为 ε>0 的奖励和转移核条目可能发生变化。在这种设定下，从头学习每个待部署模型可能会丢弃以往部署中有用的观测，而将所有过去的观测汇集在一起则可能使已经发生变化条目的估计产生偏差。为此，我们提出一种算法：针对每个状态-动作对，选择复用多少历史数据来估计奖励和下一状态的概率。我们从当前部署的观测开始，按由近及远的顺序逐个加入更早部署的观测。在每次添加后，我们检验是否单一的……
tldr: 针对部署间稀疏变化的强化学习环境，提出一种自适应记忆算法，为每个状态-动作对动态决定复用多少历史观测，从而在利用过去数据与避免已变化条目带来的估计偏差之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: An adaptive memory algorithm for online RL under sparse model changes across deployments, which dynamically selects how much historical data to reuse for each state-action pair, balancing the value of past observations against estimation bias from changed model entries.
